# PaintFE v1.4.10

This update adds JPEG XL support, makes numeric controls more consistent and improves scrolling in Preferences.

## New

- Open JPEG XL images and save them on desktop with lossless or lossy compression. Choose the encoding effort, check the preview or convert files through the CLI. The encoder is built in, so there is no extra codec DLL to install.
- Double-click a slider track to restore its default where one is available. Number fields still support text editing. Optional theme values return to the theme default. The gesture can be turned off under Preferences > Interface > Motion and interaction details.

## Fixed

- Numeric editors, sliders, colour fields and step buttons now share the same controls across dialogs, tool settings and Preferences. This keeps typing, dragging, keyboard adjustments and resets consistent without changing the colour panel's triangular slider style.
- Preferences does less work while scrolling. Offscreen sections reuse their measured layout, the colour wheel reuses its geometry, and unchanged AI paths are no longer checked on disk every frame. The Interface page also keeps wheel scrolling from changing numeric values.
- Hovering over a menu no longer picks up panel resize or drag cursors from underneath it.
- Corrected the translated print-window title for browser builds.

## Maintenance

- Added shared-control documentation and an automated audit to help prevent controls drifting apart again.
- Updated the pinned CI actions from pull requests 175, 176 and 177, and added JPEG XL codec checks to CI.

Related issue: 185. It remains open for users to test and confirm. Further testing is continuing.
